description: Defines an abstract Android activity class 'BaseActivity' that provides shared functionality for other activities, including lifecycle management, intent handling, UI setup, and task management.

classes.name: BaseActivity
classes.description: An abstract class providing shared activity functionality including lifecycle management, intent handling, UI setup, and task management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads the launch mode.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume, tracks activity, and processes launch forwarding.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles activity destruction and tracking cleanup.

methods.name: addTrackerListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the tracking system.

methods.name: removeTrackerListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the tracking system.

methods.name: loadMode
methods.description: Sets up the UI based on the specified mode (LAUNCH, VERIFY, RESULT).

methods.name: launchActivity
methods.description: Starts a new activity, optionally for a result, and manages fragment back stack.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received by the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including running tests and launching tasks.

methods.name: askToLaunchTasks
methods.description: Displays a dialog to confirm launching predefined tasks.

methods.name: setupTaskPreset
methods.description: Creates a preset task hierarchy for testing.

methods.name: runIntentTests
methods.description: Attempts to launch test activities for the app.

methods.name: prepareLaunchForward
methods.description: Prepares the intent to forward to the next activity if specified.

methods.name: onUserLeaveHint
methods.description: Sets a flag when the user leaves the activity.
